name: Booty Hunters! Digital
storyline: Rival Admirals set sail across dangerous waters in search of treasure, glory and control of the seas. Each commands a distinctive faction with its own ships, captains and abilities, battling enemy fleets and creatures of the deep while racing to deliver their plunder and claim victory.
summary:
Booty Hunters! Digital is a pirate-themed, turn-based naval strategy game in which rival Admirals command unique factions, assemble fleets, and compete to become the wealthiest pirate on the seas. Played across a tactical hex-based ocean, the game combines treasure hunting, ship-to-ship combat, crew management, and strategic naval maneuvering. Players commission vessels, recruit crews, fire cannons, board enemy ships, encounter sea monsters, and capture treasure while navigating the strengths and weaknesses of opposing fleets.

Each faction features distinct captains, ships, special abilities, and combat mechanics that influence fleet composition and strategic decisions. Victory can be achieved through competing treasure-delivery objectives, requiring players to balance offensive tactics, fleet preservation, and resource management. The game supports single-player matches against computer-controlled opponents and online multiplayer across web browsers and Discord.
